displayName: Recipe: spike of per-account limit refusals

documentation.content: More generations than usual were refused for an account's daily limits in the last hour: `USER_DAILY_LIMIT` (the account's generations or estimated spend for the day) or `INFRA_FAILURE_LIMIT` (too many refunded technical failures today), counted from `generation_refused` lines (`reason`, `why`, `uidHash`; sampled at 30 a minute per instance). Many at once point at a script, a client retry loop, or the model failing. See functions/README.md, "Alerts".

conditions.displayName: USER_DAILY_LIMIT refusals above 20 in an hour
INFRA_FAILURE_LIMIT refusals above 5 in an hour
